topic: The repo that went from 9k to 210k stars
angle: One tool, one year, and what it says about where AI is going
hook: This repo went from 9K to 210K stars
caption:
OpenClaw went from nine thousand stars to over sixty thousand in a matter of days, and has since passed two hundred and ten thousand. It is a personal AI assistant that runs locally and connects to the apps you already use. The number is interesting; what it signals is more interesting.

🔖 Save this — the links are all free.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#openclaw #opensource #aitools #github #localai

slides.text: This repo went from *9K to 210K* stars
slides.subline: And it runs entirely on your own machine

slides.text: Two hundred thousand people bookmarked the same tool in a year. That is worth understanding whether or not you install it.

slides.caption: from nine thousand, in roughly twelve months

slides.title: What it actually does
slides.body: It runs a personal AI assistant on your own device and wires it to over fifty services — WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, iMessage. Your messages never leave your machine to reach it.

slides.left_text: Your conversations live on someone else's server, priced per month.
slides.right_text: Runs locally, connects to the apps you already use, costs nothing.

slides.title: The signal underneath
slides.body: Teams that spent two years on proprietary pilots are coming back to open source, because closed tools cannot reach their actual systems. That is the trend the star count is measuring.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
